hints.title: Suffix Flip Effect
hints.text: A flip at index i inverts all characters from index i to the end of the string.

hints.title: Greedy Left-to-Right Processing
hints.text: To avoid disturbing earlier matched positions, process characters from left to right.

hints.title: State Transition Counting
hints.text: Track the current state of the trailing suffix. Whenever target[i] differs from the current state, a flip is mandatory.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Actually flipping strings repeatedly takes O(N^2) time, giving TLE on N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating only the active state flips in a single pass achieves O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate counts parity transitions without performing physical suffix updates.
